$AUVEN / SOLANA

The role of
$AUVEN.

We are moving AUVEN's wallet and proof infrastructure to Solana. The Solana token mint has not been published yet, so balance checks and holder proofs are not available during this transition. Agent controls and post-quantum signed activity continue to work.

$AUVEN IN THE PRODUCT

What we are preparing.

These token utilities are planned. AUVEN does not currently grant higher limits for holding tokens or accept token payments.

01 / HOLDER PROOFPREPARING

Show what you hold.

Create a signed balance record for an agent once the Solana token mint is available.

Linked wallet → balance check → agent proof
02 / HOLDER BENEFITSPLANNED

Higher limits for your agents.

We plan to give eligible holders higher request limits. We will publish the required balance and benefits before launch.

Token holding → eligibility → higher limits
03 / TOKEN PAYMENTSPLANNED

Pay for AUVEN services.

We plan to accept $AUVEN for selected services. Prices and payment terms will be shown before any payment.

Choose a service → see the price → pay
BUYBACK AND BURN / PLANNED

Use service revenue to buy and burn $AUVEN.

We plan to use a defined share of AUVEN service revenue to buy $AUVEN and burn the purchased tokens. We will publish the share, timing, and transaction records before this starts. Buybacks and burns are not active today.

AUVEN service revenue→Buy $AUVEN→Burn purchased tokens
POST-QUANTUM PROOF

A record you can
check yourself.

Agent passports and activity checkpoints already use ML-DSA-65 signatures that you can export and verify. The same format is prepared for future Solana holder proofs. A separate Solana transaction can record a proof commitment when publication is configured.
